reason: In packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts:189-195, both computed keys evaluate to "[object Object]", so in sync mode the schema only keeps access_token and Zod's default strip mode drops expires_in. VideoApiAdapter.ts:122 then sets expiry_date to NaN and stores it, and the next getToken call fails at zoomTokenSchema.parse (line 132, `expiry_date: z.number()` at line 54) because the value is NaN, or null once serialised.
